client/src/components/execution/SafeHTML.name: Report viewer

client/src/components/execution/Schedule.name: Run scheduling

client/src/components/files/FilesInspect.name: File details panel
client/src/components/files/FilesInspect.description: Shows the details of the selected file or folder beside the listing, and closes cleanly.

client/src/components/files/FolderListin.name: Folder contents
client/src/components/files/FolderListin.description: Lists what is inside a folder with versions, sharing state and actions on each entry.

client/src/components/files/InlineLoader.name: Loading indicator

client/src/components/files/NewShareDial.name: New share dialog

client/src/components/files/SharesOvervi.name: Shares overview
client/src/components/files/SharesOvervi.description: Summarises the shares in scope and what each one makes available.

client/src/components/files/ShareTree.ts.name: Share contents

client/src/components/files/TestAccessMo.name: Access test

client/src/components/LogoDropZone.tsx.name: Logo uploader

client/src/components/NoAccess.tsx.name: Access denied screen
